description: Sanitized assistant responses from synthetic Qwen incident runs; untrusted test data only.

evidence.description: Deploy v2.8.1 replacing v2.8.0; configuration template changed DB_POOL_MAX from 50 to 5.

evidence.message: Database connection acquisition timeout after 3000ms; active=5; max=5; waiters=82; trace_id=trace-order-slow-01.
POST /orders returned HTTP 504; database connection acquisition timeout; trace_id=trace-order-slow-02.

evidence.title: Request latency and timeout triage
evidence.content: Correlate metrics, logs, traces and deployments within the same incident window. Separate observed facts from candidate causes. Require a change ticket and human approval for production writes.

evidence.title: Connection pool saturation after release / 发布后连接池耗尽
evidence.content: When acquisition latency and waiters rise, compare effective pool settings and recent configuration changes. Check total database connection headroom across all replicas before increasing pool size. Low database CPU alone does not prove database health. An approved operator must review rollback compatibility, canary scope and abort thresholds. This reference is not evidence that a current remediation succeeded.
